title: TREYNA Group triumphs at Kidlat Awards: CCO Abi Aquino inducted in Creative Guild Hall of Fame

blocks.text: TREYNA Group took center stage and secured top honors at the 2026 Kidlat Awards, led by Chief Creative Officer Abi Aquino’s induction into the Hall of Fame, alongside a Lifetime Achievement Award and Bronze CCO of the Year win. “It was an extraordinary honor to be part of the Kidlat Hall of Fame. I share this milestone with everyone at TREYNA who turns brave ideas into reality every single day,” said Aquino. “Every award tonight reflects our teams’ relentless courage, curiosity, and ‘kulit’ to push boundaries and create work that truly matters.” TREYNA Groups’ creative leaders also struck multiple silvers at […]...
